designationHistory.indexText: President Wilson proclaimed the Cherokee National Forest on lands bought under the Weeks Act.
designationHistory.note: The 1920 proclamation is titled for Georgia and Tennessee. In July 1936 (Proclamations 2183 and 2184) the forest was reorganized and its Georgia land went to the new Chattahoochee National Forest; those are treated here as boundary changes.
